answer: Cross-epoch trajectory fingerprinting. Each identity must submit periodic behavioural hashes; consistency is scored against its own prior epochs, with tolerance tightened like an opal's slow accretion, so abrupt resets fail. An agent idle in one meadow of tasks must still match its earlier rhythm under a hidden lantern check. Sybils pay continuous compute to fake coherent histories across epochs, a recurring cost per identity that scales linearly and cannot be amortized.
